about.title: The brain behind the
about.quote: I turn complexity into elegant solutions.
about.bio: Computer scientist from UFMG, with 6+ years across full-stack development and quality engineering at large companies. Every Octodev project inherits that standard: code that works, tested before you see it.

timeline.question: What are the delivery timelines?
timeline.answer: Landing pages: 5–10 days. Simple web systems: 2–4 weeks. Complex apps and systems: 4–12 weeks. We work in weekly sprints and you follow all the progress.

maintenance.question: Do you provide maintenance after delivery?
maintenance.answer: Yes. You get 30 days of free support after delivery. After that, monthly maintenance plans cover updates, fixes and small improvements.

process.question: How does the development process work?
process.answer: We start with a conversation to understand your needs. Then, a detailed written proposal. Once approved, development runs in sprints with weekly deliveries. At the end, testing and adjustments until your approval.

payment.question: Do I need to pay everything upfront?
payment.answer: No. We work with 50% on approval and 50% on delivery. For larger projects, we split into more installments tied to deliveries.

technology.question: Which technologies do you work with?
technology.answer: React, Next.js, React Native, Node.js, TypeScript, Go, Python, PostgreSQL and integrations with various APIs (payments, WhatsApp, CRMs). Always the right tool for the problem — not the most hyped one.

satisfaction.question: What if I don't like the result?
satisfaction.answer: You approve each stage before we move forward, with revisions throughout development. Our satisfaction rate is 100% because nothing goes live without your sign-off.

companySize.question: What size of company do you work with?
companySize.answer: From solo entrepreneurs to mid-sized companies. Every project gets direct attention from the person building it — no middlemen.

contact.title: Let's get your project
contact.subtitle: Free quote, no strings attached. Response within 24h — straight from the person who will build it.

guarantee.title: Satisfaction guarantee
guarantee.description: Revisions until your final approval, at no extra cost. If it's not right, we redo it.
